Administration in renal impairment. Dabigatran is excret- ed mainly by the kidneys but there is limited clinical experience with its use in renal impairment. It is contra-indicated in patients with creatinine clearance (CC) below 30 mL/minute. In patients with CC between 30 and 50 mL/minute the initial dose should be the equivalent of 75 mg of dabigatran etexilate given within 1 to 4 hours of the completion of surgery, followed by 150 mg once daily for a total of 10 days after knee replacement and 28 to 35 days after hip replacement.
